before: Medical malpractice cases are expensive to litigate due to the need for expert witnesses, medical record review, life care planning, and extensive discovery. Cases typically cost $50,000 to $200,000+ in expenses before trial. At Roden Law, we advance all costs on a contingency basis — you pay nothing upfront, and we only recover fees and expenses if we win your case. This allows victims to pursue justice regardless of their financial situation.
